items.textEn: To reduce lifting and chipping, avoid prolonged soaking and wear gloves for dishes and cleaning, especially during the first 24 hours.
items.textZh: 为减少翘起和崩裂，请避免长时间浸水，并在洗碗和清洁时佩戴手套，尤其是在完成美甲后的前24小时。

items.textEn: Avoid applying pressure directly to the tips of your nails.
items.textZh: 避免对指甲尖端施加直接压力。

items.textEn: Your gel should be fully cured before you leave. If it feels soft, wrinkles, or changes unexpectedly, contact the studio.
items.textZh: 光疗胶应在您离开工作室前完全固化。如果甲面发软、起皱或出现异常变化，请联系工作室。

items.textEn: Apply cuticle oil once or twice daily to keep nails and skin hydrated.
items.textZh: 每日涂抹一至两次护甲油，保持指甲和皮肤水润。

items.textEn: Moisturize your hands regularly, especially after washing.
items.textZh: 经常给双手保湿，尤其是洗手之后。

items.textEn: Avoid using your nails as tools — do not pry, pick, or scrape with them.
items.textZh: 避免用指甲作为工具 — 不要用指甲撬、抠或刮物品。

items.textEn: Wear protective gloves when cleaning, doing dishes, or using harsh chemicals.
items.textZh: 清洁、洗碗或使用强效化学品时，请戴上防护手套。

items.textEn: Avoid prolonged contact with acetone-based products (e.g., nail polish remover).
items.textZh: 避免长时间接触含丙酮的产品（如卸甲水）。

items.textEn: Before a gel manicure, apply broad-spectrum, water-resistant SPF 30+ sunscreen to your hands, or wear dark, opaque fingerless gloves, to help protect your skin from UV exposure.
items.textZh: 做光疗美甲前，请在手部涂抹广谱、防水、SPF 30或以上的防晒霜，或佩戴深色不透光的露指手套，以帮助保护皮肤免受紫外线照射。

items.textEn: Do not peel, pick, or force-remove gel — this damages the natural nail underneath.
items.textZh: 不要撕、抠或强行卸除光疗胶 — 这会损伤下方的天然甲。

items.textEn: If the gel coating lifts or chips, do not pick it or glue it down; contact the studio. If your natural nail separates, becomes discoloured, or is painful, seek advice from a healthcare professional.
items.textZh: 如果美甲胶层翘起或崩裂，请勿抠撕或用胶水粘回，并联系工作室。如果天然甲分离、变色或疼痛，请咨询医疗专业人员。

items.textEn: Stop using nail products and seek medical advice if you develop persistent itching, burning, redness, swelling, blistering, rash, nail separation, unusual discolouration, or drainage. Facial swelling or breathing difficulty requires urgent medical care.
items.textZh: 如果出现持续瘙痒、灼热、发红、肿胀、水疱、皮疹、天然甲分离、异常变色或渗液，请停止使用美甲产品并寻求医疗建议。如出现面部肿胀或呼吸困难，请立即就医。

items.textEn: Professional removal is recommended, particularly for hard gel, extensions, or when you are unsure of the product. Never peel or aggressively file off the coating.
items.textZh: 建议由专业人员卸甲，尤其是硬胶、延长甲，或您不确定所用产品类型时。切勿撕除胶层或过度打磨。

items.textEn: Book a removal appointment when ready. Based on the product type, we'll safely soak off or file down the existing nail product.
items.textZh: 需要卸甲时请预约卸甲服务。我们会根据产品类型，安全地浸泡卸除或打磨卸除原有的美甲产品。

items.textEn: If your nails feel thin, brittle, or sensitive, take a one- to two-week break—or longer if needed—and moisturize regularly. Seek medical advice if symptoms persist.
items.textZh: 如果指甲感觉变薄、脆弱或敏感，请暂停美甲一至两周，必要时可延长，并定期保湿。如果症状持续，请寻求医疗建议。
